properties.description:
Support creating/joining spaces and creating/composing buildspaces as data through configured capabilities, without recompiling or restarting. Startup scripts seed the initial setup rather than becoming the entire live inventory.

Implementation progress: Implemented a contributor-owned, revision-checked space catalog seeded once by configuration. Spaces and cross-template buildspace memberships can be edited live, survive reload, and materialize canonical space nodes through the local engine. Focused persistence/stale-write and dynamic-space browser checks pass; final integration verification remains.

Slice verification completed: The owner catalog and browser recordings verify live space creation, editing and cross-template buildspace membership, persisted across reload with stale writes rejected. These operations require no application restart.
properties.title: Keep spaces and buildspaces live and composable
